DdbError400.description: The request or its ProtoJSON representation is invalid.

DdbError401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid.

DdbError403.description: The authenticated principal lacks the required scope.

DdbError404.description: The addressed resource does not exist.

DdbError409.description: The request conflicts with current resource state. The addressed operation cannot currently be cancelled.

DdbError410.description: The requested stream cursor is no longer retained. The addressed ephemeral resource has expired.

DdbError412.description: A required debugger or DDB precondition is not satisfied.

DdbError429.description: A documented resource or admission limit was exceeded.

DdbError500.description: The server could not classify an internal failure. The server encountered an internal failure.

DdbError501.description: The requested typed capability is not supported.

DdbError502.description: The debugger backend failed the request. A fanout request completed with one or more target failures.

DdbError503.description: The addressed target or service is not ready. A required service or debugger backend is unavailable.
